hypotheses.justification: hB is used only to supply `hB.prod measurableSet_Ioc` to the two `setIntegral_congr_ae` calls (hleft and hright). In both calls the integrands agree at every point, not just on the set. In hleft, after `rw [hτsymm, parabolicHomeomorph_symm_apply]` the goal is closed by `buGaussian_timeShift_point_symm_apply σ q`, which is stated for every point and takes no membership hypothesis. The hypothesis `hqmem` is never used. In hright, `simp [F]` closes the goal pointwise. So both calls can be replaced by the non-set version `integral_congr_ae` with `Filter.Eventually.of_forall`, or by rewriting with `funext`, and no measurability is needed. The other steps do not need it either. `MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb` takes a measurable embedding and no measurability of the set. `setIntegral_parabolic_to_product` has no hypotheses. `himage` is purely set-theoretic. The theorem is therefore provable, and so true, without hB.
